Name: Advanced Seed Maker
Author: Toskopado
Description:
This mod allows you to make seeds much faster. It uses 5 crops to produce 6 to 15 seeds, or, if you prefer, you can also make fruit tree saplings with 20 fruits!

Recipe: 40 wood, 2 iridium bars, and 15 coal

Unlock the recipe at farming level 9!

Works with the automate mod if you install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5038]PFMautomate
[/url]
Please report any bugs :)
